title: Danaday Branding
challenge: Danaday needed a coherent brand and communication system for a diverse portfolio of livestock and poultry products. Packaging had to distinguish product categories while remaining adaptable to different buyer requirements. The identity, graphic materials, and website also had to be designed and produced within a limited timeframe.
outcome: A coordinated visual identity, packaging family, digital design system, catalogue, brochure, exhibition presence, and promotional communication toolkit were developed for Danaday. No unverified commercial performance claim is included.
